settings.label: Orientations
settings.help: Runs that are the same object at a different angle, matched by an entity (acq, run, rec, inv), a glob (*acq-dir*) or re:<regex>; empty turns grouping off. How the orientations are combined is set under Multi-orientation

settings.label: Axial Resampling
settings.help: Resample oblique acquisitions onto an axial grid when they are tilted more than the threshold. Off: reconstruct on the acquired grid with the true B0 direction

settings.label: Obliquity Threshold (°)
settings.help: Resample only data more oblique than this

settings.label: Output Space
settings.help: The grid derivatives are written on, when an oblique run was resampled to axial

options.label: acquired
options.name: Acquired grid
options.help: Write derivatives back on the acquired grid when the run was resampled to axial

options.label: working
options.name: Working grid
options.help: Leave derivatives on the resampled (axial) working grid, avoiding a second interpolation

settings.label: Inhomog. Correction
settings.help: Apply B1 field correction to magnitude (improves masking, ROMEO weights, MEDI edges, SWI)

settings.label: Sigma (mm)
settings.help: Smoothing sigma of the bias-field estimate

settings.label: Ignore Slice Gap
settings.help: Reconstruct even if the sidecar's SliceThickness is thinner than the slice pitch (gapped 2D data gives a wrong map)

settings.label: Crop to Mask
settings.help: Run the FFT-bound stages on a box around the mask (faster; outputs stay on the full grid)

settings.label: Crop Margin (mm)
settings.help: Margin around the mask; below about 32 mm results start to differ, and it must clear the largest SMV kernel

settings.label: FFT Padding
settings.help: Pad the grid to an FFT-friendly size before the FFT-bound stages (faster on awkward grids; shifts results slightly)

settings.label: Coil Comb. Sigma
settings.help: MCPC-3D-S smoothing of the per-coil phase offsets (x y z); only for uncombined multi-coil data

settings.label: Mask
settings.help: The mask recipe: one or more sections, each an input image, a generator and its refinements, combined with OR or AND

settings.label: Combined With
settings.help: How the sections are combined: OR keeps a voxel any section keeps, AND only one every section keeps

options.label: OR
options.name: OR
options.help: A voxel is in the mask when any section keeps it

options.label: AND
options.name: AND
options.help: A voxel is in the mask when every section keeps it

settings.label: Combined Mask Steps
settings.help: Refinement steps run on the combined mask, after the sections are combined

settings.label: Use custom masks
settings.help: Use a mask from <bids>/derivatives/<tool>/ instead of computing one: * for any tool, or a tool name (e.g. bet); empty to always compute it. Where none is found, the mask is computed
settings.browser_help: A brain mask to use instead of computing one from the mask recipe

settings.label: Two-pass Artefact Reduction
settings.help: Reconstruct again on a mask whose holes are left unfilled and keep that result where it is defined — keeps streaking from strong sources out of the rest of the brain, at roughly double the reconstruction time (doi:10.1002/mrm.29048)

settings.label: Smoothness
settings.help: BET surface smoothness factor (shared by every BET step)

settings.label: Gradient Threshold
settings.help: BET gradient threshold, from -1 to 1 (shared by every BET step)

settings.label: Iterations
settings.help: BET surface evolution iterations (shared by every BET step)

settings.label: Subdivisions
settings.help: BET icosphere subdivision level (shared by every BET step)

settings.label: Reliable Mask
settings.help: The mask the second pass reconstructs on: its holes are left unfilled. Empty = the main mask without its hole filling

settings.label: Motion Correction
settings.help: Rigidly co-register every echo onto a reference echo before any other stage (multi-echo, needs magnitude)

settings.label: Reference
settings.help: The echo every other echo is aligned onto
settings.value_help: The echo the others are aligned onto, counted from 1

options.label: first
options.name: First echo
options.help: Align every echo onto the first (best SNR; the published procedure)

options.label: last
options.name: Last echo
options.help: Align every echo onto the last

options.label: echo
options.name: Echo number
options.help: Align every echo onto a given echo (Reference Echo)

settings.label: Chain
settings.help: Seed each echo's registration from its neighbour's solution

settings.label: Chain Levels
settings.help: Pyramid levels for a seeded registration

settings.label: Min NCC
settings.help: Normalised cross-correlation below which a registration is reported as suspect (0.3 for echoes; about 0.9 for repeats)

settings.label: Levels
settings.help: Pyramid levels: the capture range; do not lower

settings.label: Max Samples
settings.help: Voxels sampled per metric evaluation, per level

settings.label: Max Evaluations
settings.help: Metric evaluations across all levels (hard stop)

settings.label: Tolerance
settings.help: Relative cost improvement per cycle that counts as converged

settings.label: Rotation Step (deg)
settings.help: Initial rotation step at the finest level

settings.label: Translation Step (mm)
settings.help: Initial translation step at the finest level

settings.label: Min Overlap
settings.help: Smallest fraction of sampled voxels that must overlap

settings.label: Unwrapping
settings.help: How the wrapped phase is unwrapped

options.label: romeo
options.name: ROMEO
options.help: ROMEO region-growing unwrapping

options.label: laplacian
options.name: Laplacian
options.help: Laplacian phase unwrapping (FFT-based)

settings.label: Solver
settings.help: How Laplacian unwrapping's Poisson equation is solved

options.label: dct
options.name: DCT
options.help: Unweighted least squares, Neumann-boundary DCT solve (Ghiglia & Romero 1994; QSM.jl :dct)

options.label: fft
options.name: FFT
options.help: Schofield & Zhu sin/cos Laplacian, FFT solve on a zero-padded volume

settings.label: FFT Pad (voxels)
settings.help: Zero-padding per side: one value for every axis, or three (x y z)

settings.label: Phase Offset Removal
settings.help: Remove spatially-varying phase offset using HIP (Eckstein et al., 2018); multi-echo only

settings.label: Bipolar Correction
settings.help: Remove the linear phase artefact of bipolar readout gradients (needs at least 3 echoes; fewer: skipped)

settings.label: Individual Mode
settings.help: Unwrap each echo independently (recommended). Off = template-based temporal unwrapping.

settings.label: Template Echo
settings.help: Echo used for spatial unwrapping, counted from 0

settings.label: Phase Coherence
settings.help: Weight edges by neighbour phase coherence

settings.label: Phase Gradient Coherence
settings.help: Weight edges by inter-echo phase-gradient consistency (multi-echo)

settings.label: Mag Coherence
settings.help: Weight edges by neighbour magnitude coherence

settings.label: Mag Weight 2
settings.help: Penalise abnormally high signal and flow artefacts

settings.label: Best-path Weights
settings.help: Use Abdul-Rahman best-path weights instead of ROMEO weights

settings.label: Temporal Uncertain
settings.help: Re-unwrap voxels whose temporal unwrapping is uncertain
settings.value_help: Quality threshold (0, 1] below which a voxel is re-unwrapped

settings.label: Correct Regions
settings.help: Shift each region by a multiple of 2π to bring its median nearest 0

settings.label: Wrap Addition
settings.help: Extra phase tolerance beyond π for neighbour differences, from 0 to π

settings.label: B0 Estimation
settings.help: How the unwrapped echoes are combined into one field map

options.label: weighted-avg
options.name: Weighted average
options.help: Weighted average of phase/TE across echoes

options.label: linear-fit
options.name: Linear fit
options.help: Magnitude-weighted linear fit of phase vs TE

options.label: robust-fit
options.name: Robust fit
options.help: Motion-robust linear fit (IRLS): down-weights echoes departing from a straight line, per voxel. Needs 4 echoes (3 without offset)

settings.label: Weight Type
settings.help: How each echo is weighted in the average

options.label: phase-snr
options.name: Phase SNR
options.help: mag × TE — optimal for phase SNR

options.label: phase-var
options.name: Phase variance
options.help: mag² × TE² — based on phase variance

options.label: average
options.name: Uniform
options.help: Uniform weights (unweighted average)

options.label: tes
options.name: Echo time
options.help: TE only

options.label: mag
options.name: Magnitude
options.help: Magnitude only

options.label: assumed-decay
options.name: Assumed decay
options.help: Fixed TE·exp(−TE/T2*) per echo from an assumed T2* (no T2* map, no magnitude); phase-snr is generally better

settings.label: Assumed T2* (ms)
settings.help: T2* assumed to compute the fixed echo weights; no T2* map is used

settings.label: Estimate Offset
settings.help: Fit a phase-offset term in the echo-time fit (robust fit: needs 4 echoes with it, 3 without)

settings.label: Reliability Mask
settings.help: Report the fit's reliability mask; does not change the field map
settings.value_help: Percentile of the fit residual above which a voxel counts as unreliable

settings.label: Loss
settings.help: The loss that down-weights an echo departing from the straight line through the others

options.label: tukey
options.name: Tukey
options.help: Tukey biweight: rejects an echo at a voxel past the tuning radius

options.label: huber
options.name: Huber
options.help: Huber: caps an outlying echo's influence but never rejects it

settings.label: Tuning
settings.help: Tuning radius in robust-scale units; empty for the conventional value (Tukey 4.685, Huber 1.345)

settings.label: Iterations
settings.help: Iteratively reweighted passes (0 reports only: the field map is the linear fit's)

settings.label: Downweight Level
settings.help: Reporting only: a weight below this counts as down-weighted

settings.label: Flag Ratio
settings.help: Reporting only: flag an echo whose outlier score exceeds this multiple of the best echo's

settings.label: BG Removal
settings.help: How the background field, from sources outside the mask, is removed to leave the local field

options.label: vsharp
options.name: V-SHARP
options.help: Variable-kernel SHARP (V-SHARP)

options.label: pdf
options.name: PDF
options.help: Projection onto Dipole Fields (PDF)

options.label: lbv

options.help: Laplacian Boundary Value (LBV)

options.label: ismv
options.name: iSMV
options.help: Iterative Spherical Mean Value (iSMV)

options.label: sharp
options.name: SHARP
options.help: SHARP (Sophisticated Harmonic Artifact Reduction)

options.label: resharp
options.name: RESHARP
options.help: Regularized SHARP (RESHARP) with Tikhonov

options.label: harperella
options.name: HARPERELLA
options.help: HARPERELLA integrated unwrap+BFR

options.label: iharperella
options.name: iHARPERELLA
options.help: Improved HARPERELLA (iHARPERELLA) — Li et al., Proc. ISMRM 2015, p.3313

options.label: bfrnet
options.name: BFRnet
options.help: BFRnet deep-learning background removal (weights auto-downloaded)

options.label: iqfm
options.name: iQFM
options.help: iQFM deep-learning joint unwrapping + background removal from phase (weights auto-downloaded)

settings.label: Deconvolve
settings.help: Undo the SMV high-pass with a truncated-SVD deconvolution

settings.label: Working Grid
settings.help: The voxel grid V-SHARP runs on

options.label: native
options.name: Native
options.help: The acquired voxel grid

options.label: finest
options.name: Finest
options.help: An isotropic grid at the smallest voxel dimension, so no axis is coarsened; isotropic data stays on the acquired grid

options.label: isotropic
options.name: Isotropic
options.help: An isotropic grid of Grid Spacing mm; the background is interpolated back, the local field keeps native resolution

settings.label: mSMV refinement
settings.help: Remove residual boundary-field shadows with mSMV after the primary BFR (Roberts 2024)

settings.label: Compute QSM
settings.help: Enable QSM reconstruction (disable to only run the other outputs)

settings.label: QSM Inversion
settings.help: How the field is inverted into a susceptibility map

options.label: rts
options.name: RTS
options.help: RTS (Rapid Two-Step) — fast two-step k-space inversion with streaking removal.

options.label: tv
options.name: TV-ADMM
options.help: TV-ADMM (Total Variation) — ADMM inversion with a total-variation prior.

options.label: tkd
options.name: TKD
options.help: TKD (Thresholded K-space Division) — direct k-space division with thresholding.

options.label: tsvd
options.name: TSVD
options.help: TSVD (Truncated SVD) — zeroes the small singular values of the dipole kernel.

options.label: tgv
options.name: TGV
options.help: TGV (Total Generalized Variation) — single-step: unwrapping, background removal and inversion together.

options.label: tikhonov
options.name: Tikhonov
options.help: Tikhonov — closed-form L2-regularized inversion.

options.label: nltv
options.name: NLTV
options.help: NLTV (Nonlinear Total Variation) — nonlinear data fidelity with a TV prior.

options.label: medi
options.name: MEDI
options.help: MEDI (Morphology Enabled Dipole Inversion) — magnitude-guided edge weighting.

options.label: tfi
options.name: TFI
options.help: TFI (Total Field Inversion) — inverts the total field directly (its own background removal).

options.label: ilsqr
options.name: iLSQR
options.help: iLSQR — iterative LSQR with streaking-artifact correction.

options.label: lsqr
options.name: LSQR
options.help: LSQR (minimally regularised) — one least-squares solve for χ plus a residual field; the residual weight is the only regularisation.

options.label: heidi
options.name: HEIDI
options.help: HEIDI (Homogeneity Enabled Incremental Dipole Inversion) — keeps the well-conditioned k-space of an LSQR solve and re-derives the dipole cone under a homogeneity prior.

options.label: qsmart
options.name: QSMART
options.help: QSMART — two-stage spatially-dependent filtering plus inversion.

options.label: ndi
options.name: NDI
options.help: NDI (Nonlinear Dipole Inversion) — gradient-descent nonlinear fit.

options.label: fansi
options.name: FANSI (TV)
options.help: FANSI (Nonlinear TV) — fast nonlinear susceptibility inversion with a TV prior.

options.label: fansi-tgv
options.name: FANSI (TGV)
options.help: FANSI (Nonlinear TGV) — FANSI with a total-generalized-variation prior.

options.label: l1qsm
options.name: L1-QSM
options.help: L1-QSM (L1 Data Fidelity) — L1 fidelity for streaking suppression.

options.label: whqsm
options.name: WH-QSM
options.help: WH-QSM (Weak-Harmonic QSM) — jointly fits a residual harmonic background field.

options.label: hdqsm
options.name: HD-QSM
options.help: HD-QSM (Hybrid Data Fidelity) — combined L1/L2 data fidelity.

options.label: amp-pe

options.label: xqsm

options.label: qsmnet

options.label: qsmnet-plus
options.name: QSMnet+
options.help: QSMnet+ (deep learning; weights auto-downloaded) — QSMnet trained for a wider susceptibility range.

options.label: autoqsm

options.help: AutoQSM (deep learning; weights auto-downloaded) — single-step reconstruction, no separate background removal.

options.label: qsmgan
options.name: QSMGAN
options.help: QSMGAN (deep learning; weights auto-downloaded) — GAN-refined U-net dipole inversion.

options.label: ir2qsm

options.label: lpcnn

options.label: modl-qsm

options.label: nextqsm

options.label: iqsm

options.label: iqsm-plus

settings.label: Compute χ-separation
settings.help: Split QSM into paramagnetic (χ+, iron) and diamagnetic (χ−, myelin) maps

settings.label: Method
settings.help: The χ-separation method, and the maps it reads

options.label: r2star-qsm
options.name: R2*-QSM
options.help: R2*-QSM closed-form (Dimov 2022) — QSM + R2*, GRE-only

options.label: decompose
options.name: DECOMPOSE-QSM
options.help: DECOMPOSE-QSM signal-domain fit (Chen 2021) — QSM + multi-echo magnitude, GRE-only

options.label: chi-sep-ilsqr
options.name: χ-separation (iLSQR)
options.help: χ-separation iLSQR (Shin 2021) — local field + R2' + magnitude + QSM

options.label: chi-sep-medi
options.name: χ-separation (MEDI)
options.help: χ-separation MEDI — local field + R2' + magnitude

options.label: wavesep
options.name: WaveSep
options.help: WaveSep wavelet-L1 (Fang 2023) — QSM + R2'

options.label: hc-chisep
options.name: Hollow-cylinder χ-separation
options.help: Hollow-cylinder χ-separation (Stewart 2026) — QSM + R2' + multi-echo magnitude

options.label: susep-net
options.name: SUSEP-Net
options.help: SUSEP-Net deep-learning separation — QSM + R2' + local field (weights auto-downloaded)

options.label: chi-sepnet
options.name: χ-sepnet
options.help: χ-sepnet deep-learning separation — QSM + R2' + local field (weights auto-downloaded)

settings.label: Relaxometric const @3T
settings.help: Relaxometric constant at 3 T (scales with B0)

settings.label: Chi bound (ppm)
settings.help: Upper bound on |χ| in the fit

settings.label: R2' min (Hz)
settings.help: Lower end of the R2' reliability window

settings.label: R2' max (Hz)
settings.help: Upper end of the R2' reliability window

settings.label: R2' bin (Hz)
settings.help: R2' bin width for the anchored grid search

settings.label: Custom QSM tool
settings.help: Use a χ map (Chimap) from <bids>/derivatives/<tool>/ instead of computing QSM, for χ-separation, the statistics and SMWI: * for any tool, or a tool name; empty to compute it
settings.browser_help: A susceptibility (χ) map to use instead of computing QSM, for χ-separation, the statistics and SMWI

settings.label: Compute SWI
settings.help: Also compute susceptibility-weighted images with CLEAR-SWI, from every echo

settings.label: Unwrapping
settings.help: How the phase is unwrapped and high-pass filtered for SWI

options.label: laplacian
options.name: Laplacian
options.help: Each echo unwrapped with the Laplacian method and high-pass filtered, then combined

options.label: laplacian-slice
options.name: Laplacian per slice
options.help: Laplacian unwrapping slice by slice, for 2D multi-slice acquisitions

options.label: romeo
options.name: ROMEO
options.help: All echoes unwrapped together with ROMEO, combined, then high-pass filtered

settings.label: Scaling
settings.help: How the filtered phase is turned into the mask the magnitude is multiplied by

options.label: tanh
options.name: Tanh
options.help: Phase scaling type for SWI

options.label: negative-tanh
options.name: Negative tanh
options.help: Phase scaling type for SWI

options.label: positive
options.name: Positive
options.help: Phase scaling type for SWI

options.label: negative
options.name: Negative
options.help: Phase scaling type for SWI

options.label: triangular
options.name: Triangular
options.help: Phase scaling type for SWI

settings.label: Strength
settings.help: Phase scaling strength (higher = stronger phase contrast)

settings.label: HP Sigma (x y z)
settings.help: High-pass filter sigma per axis (x y z): background phase removal. Set z to 0 for thin axial slices

settings.label: Compute SMWI
settings.help: Susceptibility map-weighted imaging — weights the magnitude by a mask built from χ, not from filtered phase. Needs QSM

settings.label: Threshold
settings.help: |χ| at which the weighting mask reaches zero. 1 ppm targets strong sources; brain tissue wants far less

settings.label: Power
settings.help: Power the mask is raised to (contrast strength)

settings.label: Compute T2* Map
settings.help: Compute T2* relaxation map (requires 3+ echoes with magnitude)

settings.label: Compute R2* Map
settings.help: Compute R2* decay rate map (requires 3+ echoes with magnitude)

settings.label: Compute R2 Map
settings.help: R2 map from a multi-echo spin-echo (MESE) acquisition via EPG. Forced on when χ-separation needs it

settings.label: Custom R2 tool
settings.help: Use an R2 map from <bids>/derivatives/<tool>/ instead of computing it from MESE: * for any tool, or a tool name; empty to compute it
settings.browser_help: An R2 map to use instead of computing one from a MESE acquisition

settings.label: Compute R2' Map
settings.help: R2' = R2* − R2; needs GRE magnitude and a MESE acquisition, or R2PRIMEnet. Forced on when χ-separation needs it

settings.label: Custom R2' tool
settings.help: Use an R2' map from <bids>/derivatives/<tool>/ instead of computing it: * for any tool, or a tool name; empty to compute it
settings.browser_help: An R2' map to use instead of computing one

settings.label: R2' Source
settings.help: How R2' is obtained when no R2' map is supplied

options.label: auto
options.name: Automatic
options.help: Measure R2' = R2* - R2 from a MESE acquisition when one is present, else predict it from R2* with R2PRIMEnet

options.label: mese
options.name: MESE
options.help: Only ever measure R2' from a MESE acquisition - produces no R2' without spin-echo data

options.label: r2primenet
options.name: R2PRIMEnet
options.help: Always predict R2' from R2* with R2PRIMEnet, even when a MESE acquisition is available (an estimate, not a measurement)

settings.label: R2PRIMEnet off 3 T
settings.help: Run R2PRIMEnet on non-3 T data (trained at 3 T only; the R2' is uncalibrated). Off: auto skips R2', r2primenet errors

settings.label: R2PRIMEnet Patch
settings.help: Sliding-window patch D H W, each a multiple of 16

settings.label: Segmentation
settings.help: Whole-brain parcellation: SynthSeg straight off the GRE magnitude, or one supplied in derivatives. Forced on by the statistics and a region reference

settings.label: Derivatives tool
settings.help: Use a segmentation (dseg) from <bids>/derivatives/<tool>/ instead of running SynthSeg: * for any tool, or a tool name. SynthSeg runs where none is found
settings.browser_help: A segmentation to use instead of running SynthSeg

settings.label: SynthSeg Version
settings.help: Which SynthSeg model segments the brain

options.label: v1
options.name: SynthSeg 1
options.help: v1: 32 labels, weights ship with SynthSeg. v2: 33 labels (adds CSF); its weights are not published yet, so a run with v2 is refused unless synthseg-2.0.onnx is in $QSM_MODEL_DIR

options.label: v2
options.name: SynthSeg 2
options.help: v1: 32 labels, weights ship with SynthSeg. v2: 33 labels (adds CSF); its weights are not published yet, so a run with v2 is refused unless synthseg-2.0.onnx is in $QSM_MODEL_DIR

settings.label: Crop
settings.help: Cubic centre crop at 1 mm before inference; empty processes the whole volume

settings.label: Flip Averaging
settings.help: Average with a left-right flipped second pass (SynthSeg's default). Doubles inference time

settings.label: Topology Cleanup
settings.help: Reset each topological class to its largest connected component

settings.label: Posterior Smoothing
settings.help: Gaussian blur on the posteriors before the labels are taken
settings.value_help: Gaussian sigma of the posterior blur

settings.label: Per-structure statistics
settings.help: Summarise every map the run makes (χ, χ+/χ−, T2*, R2*, R2, R2') per structure into a TSV: mean, SD, median, min, max, 5th/95th percentiles. Implies segmentation; implies QSM only if no other map is enabled

settings.label: Export DICOM
settings.help: Also write final maps as DICOM series into each subject's extra_files/ folder

inputs.label: Magnitude
inputs.help: The magnitude of every echo, combined (root sum of squares)

inputs.label: Phase quality
inputs.help: ROMEO's voxel quality from the phase of the first two echoes (the first alone for one echo), weighted by the combined magnitude: low where the phase is noisy or changes fast

steps.label: threshold
steps.name: Otsu threshold
steps.help: Keep the voxels of the section's image above Otsu's threshold

steps.label: threshold
steps.name: Fixed threshold
steps.help: Keep the voxels of the section's image above a value

params.label: Threshold
params.help: Voxels above this value are kept

steps.label: threshold
steps.name: Percentile threshold
steps.help: Keep the voxels of the section's image above a percentile of its positive values

params.label: Percentile
params.help: The percentile of the image's positive values above which voxels are kept

steps.label: bet
steps.name: BET
steps.help: BET brain extraction: a surface fitted to the edge of the brain in the magnitude

params.label: Fractional Intensity
params.help: Smaller values give a larger brain

params.label: Voxel Scale
params.help: Voxel sizes are multiplied by this before BET runs: its surface model is tuned to a human brain in mm, so preclinical data needs presenting at human scale (10 for mouse); 1 keeps the acquired geometry

steps.label: hd-bet
steps.name: HD-BET
steps.help: HD-BET deep-learning brain extraction from the magnitude (Isensee et al., 2019)

params.label: Inference
params.help: One pass over the whole volume, or sliding-window patches, which bound the memory

options.label: full
options.name: Whole volume
options.help: One pass over the head's bounding box at 1 mm: the fastest, and the most memory (about 6–8 GB measured on a typical adult head)

options.label: window
options.name: Sliding window
options.help: 192×192×96 patches, HD-BET's training size, half overlapping (about 3.6–4.5 GB measured)

options.label: low-memory
options.name: Low memory
options.help: 128×128×64 patches, half overlapping: the least memory (about 1.5–1.9 GB measured), and agrees with the larger patches to Dice 0.99

params.label: Mirroring TTA
params.help: 8-fold mirroring test-time augmentation: about 8 times slower

params.label: Patch Step
params.help: Sliding-window step, as a fraction of the patch: larger steps mean fewer patches and a shorter run, at softer patch seams

steps.label: mindgrab
steps.name: MindGrab
steps.help: MindGrab deep-learning brain extraction from the magnitude, for any contrast (Fani et al., 2025)

params.label: Flip TTA
params.help: Left-right flip test-time augmentation: a second, mirrored pass; about twice as slow

steps.label: rs2-net
steps.name: RS2-Net
steps.help: RS2-Net deep-learning rodent brain extraction (mouse, rat) from the magnitude (Lin et al., 2024). Its patch is fixed by the network; larger volumes are tiled

params.label: Mirroring TTA
params.help: 8-fold mirroring test-time augmentation: about 8 times slower

params.label: Patch Step
params.help: Sliding-window step, as a fraction of the patch: larger steps mean fewer patches and a shorter run, at softer patch seams

steps.label: erode
steps.name: Erode
steps.help: Remove the mask's boundary voxels, once per iteration

params.label: Iterations
params.help: How many layers of voxels to remove

steps.label: dilate
steps.name: Dilate
steps.help: Add a layer of voxels around the mask, once per iteration

params.label: Iterations
params.help: How many layers of voxels to add

steps.label: close
steps.name: Close
steps.help: Morphological closing, a dilation then an erosion with a sphere: closes gaps and dents in the edge

params.label: Radius
params.help: Radius of the sphere

steps.label: fill-holes
steps.name: Fill holes
steps.help: Fill the holes enclosed by the mask, up to a size

params.label: Largest Hole
params.help: The largest hole filled; 0 fills holes up to 5% of the volume

steps.label: gaussian
steps.name: Smooth
steps.help: Blur the mask with a Gaussian and keep the voxels above one half: rounds off its edge

params.label: Sigma
params.help: Gaussian sigma of the blur

steps.label: signal-erode
steps.name: Signal-gated erosion
steps.help: Remove only low-signal boundary voxels (sinus and skull-base dropout), with the receive-coil bias divided out of the magnitude, down to a depth cap

params.label: Threshold
params.help: Signal gate as a fraction of the in-mask median magnitude; above about 0.85 it over-carves

params.label: Depth Cap
params.help: How far below the original surface removal may reach; 0 for no cap

params.label: Plain Erosions
params.help: Plain erosions before the gate: unlike a separate erode step they spend the depth budget and leave the gate unchanged

params.label: Bias Sigma
params.help: Gaussian scale of the receive-coil bias estimate divided out of the magnitude

params.label: Minimum Component
params.help: Keep every connected component at least this large, not just the largest

hd_bet_inference.label: full
hd_bet_inference.name: Whole volume
hd_bet_inference.help: One pass over the head's bounding box at 1 mm: the fastest, and the most memory (about 6–8 GB measured on a typical adult head)

hd_bet_inference.label: window
hd_bet_inference.name: Sliding window
hd_bet_inference.help: 192×192×96 patches, HD-BET's training size, half overlapping (about 3.6–4.5 GB measured)

hd_bet_inference.label: low-memory
hd_bet_inference.name: Low memory
hd_bet_inference.help: 128×128×64 patches, half overlapping: the least memory (about 1.5–1.9 GB measured), and agrees with the larger patches to Dice 0.99

presets.name: Robust threshold
presets.help: Otsu threshold on the phase quality, then dilate, fill holes and erode. Recommended for brain

presets.name: BET
presets.help: BET brain extraction on the magnitude, then erode

presets.name: HD-BET
presets.help: HD-BET deep-learning brain extraction, then signal-gated erosion (QSM-CI harmonisation masking)

presets.name: BET and phase quality
presets.help: BET on the magnitude AND a thresholded phase quality, then fill holes and erode (ISMRM EMTP consensus)

presets.name: RS2-Net
presets.help: RS2-Net deep-learning rodent brain extraction (mouse, rat)

presets.name: MindGrab
presets.help: MindGrab deep-learning brain extraction, for any contrast
